name: Guard
author: nixfred
description: A shield in the bar that remembers what your desktop used to look like. Guard captures your Hyprland and Omarchy config on a timeline, tells you when something drifted from the state you accepted, and shows a precise before/after for putting one value back — as a preview, never an automatic write.

barWidget.description: Config drift at a glance: green while every preference you protect still holds, amber when something moved since your reference, red when a protected preference is gone or Hyprland is erroring.

schema.label: Re-read interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often Guard re-reads its own state so the shield stays current. This only re-reads what is already stored — it does not take a new capture. Captures happen when you press Capture now.

schema.label: Helper timeout (ms)
schema.description: How long Guard waits for guard.py before giving up and saying so. A timeout is always reported; it never renders as a healthy shield.
